description: Get the day's general content in one call: tarot card, angel number, crystal, mantra, moon phase, rune and I Ching. It is not a personal or per-sign reading. For a sign horoscope use vedika_horoscope, and for panchang use vedika_panchang. Consult current Vedika API pricing before use.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

lang.description: Response language code, e.g. en, hi. Default: en.

name: vedika_daily_bundle
